name: Composio
description: Slack, GitHub, Google, HubSpot, Dropbox, Box and about a thousand other apps through Composio, an outside service that signs in to them for you.
integration.summary: Signs in to Slack, GitHub, Google and other apps for you, through its cloud
integration.example: Which apps can you connect through Composio?
via.about: {name} goes through Composio, an outside service. Signing in and every request go through Composio's cloud: the account's keys are kept there, not on your hub, and Composio sees what the agent reads and sends. It needs your own Composio account (free up to 100,000 calls a month).
setup.key.title: Composio API key
setup.key.hint: Sign up at platform.composio.dev (free), then Settings → API keys → New key, and paste it here. It stays in your hub's vault.
entry.slack: Read and search channels, write messages
example.slack: What did I miss in Slack today?
example.github: Which pull requests wait for my review?
example.googledrive: Find my latest presentation on Drive
example.googlesheets: What is in my budget spreadsheet?
example.dropbox: What did I put on Dropbox this week?
detail.key: Composio did not accept the key: store a new one
detail.expired: The sign-in stopped working: sign in again
detail.waiting: Waiting for the sign-in on Composio's page
error.noKey: Composio has no key yet: store it on the card first
error.notManaged: Composio cannot sign in to {name} by itself (it needs its own OAuth client)
error.keyRejected: Composio did not accept the key
